title: The Hungry Mailboxes
rule: Every mailbox eats one letter a night, and nobody knows where they go.
ending: The kid follows the mailboxes' trail to the alley and finds a giant gift box. It opens to show a glowing giant critter reading all the letters, and it turns to the kid with a letter addressed to him.

planted.detail: a letter sticking out of the mailbox slot
Grandpa's habit of writing a letter every night
the gift box tag with the kid's name

lines.text: In this town, every mailbox eats one letter a night.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Nobody knows where the letters go.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tonight, a white letter sticks out of our mailbox.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Mom says we must never pull one back.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The street lamps flicker on as dusk falls.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Grandpa writes his letter on the porch, like always.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He slides it into the mailbox slot.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Crunch. The mailbox swallows it in one bite.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I wait until the whole street goes quiet.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: At midnight, the mailbox lid creaks open by itself.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A tiny glow pours out of the slot.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I follow the glow down the dark street.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Every mailbox glows the same pale light.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The glow leads me into a dark alley.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A giant gift box waits there, tied with a ribbon.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Its tag has my name on it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The ribbon slowly unties itself.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The lid lifts, and a giant creature sits inside.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It holds our white letter in huge paws.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It reads every word by its own glowing eyes.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It turns and hands me a letter with my name.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It is in Grandpa's handwriting.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Tell me, would you open the letter?
lines.speaker: narrator
